versions.label: In-season updated forecast
versions.method: Bayesian ridge on scoring margins: every team starts at its preseason strength (the priors model's linear predictor, converted to points by gamma) and moves toward its season-to-date opponent-adjusted margins; ridge_k is how many games of evidence the preseason prior is worth. Win probability = logistic(intercept + slope x predicted margin).
